rv.q: KAIJU romps but its leveled chaos is more fleeting than memorable.
Kaiju is an accomplished and entertaining production that proves once again how lucky we are to have The Road Theatre doing its thing in L.A.
Adventurous, hilarious, and unhinged plays used to be a regular occurrence in the LA theater scene.
Kaiju has the full package, as every design element is firing on all cylinders.

Add to that Hall’s perky Shinji, Baker’s “I just want to listen” Kyle, Snow and Faulker’s feuding couple Roy and Lee, and Kumar’s plain-talking Rani and you’ve got an all-around splendid cast who make those of us in the actual audience feel part of the show.
